connector.name: Cellarion
connector.registryDescription: Wine cellar manager: bottles, racks, drink windows, pairings and a shared wine registry.
connector.summary: Hosted at cellarion.app over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package cellarion-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace app.cellarion, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CELLARION_TOKEN
env.description: Personal API token from Settings -> API tokens (starts with cel_).

env.name: CELLARION_URL
env.description: Base URL of your Cellarion server. Leave unset for the hosted app.
